title: Meta Ads from Claude
summary: Run Facebook/Instagram ads from the command line: duplicate campaigns, change budgets, pause and resume, and pull cost-per-lead reports. Every change is shown as a plan first and only applied when you confirm.
how_to_use: Ask "how are my ads doing?", "duplicate the winning ad set", "raise the budget to $40/day".
requires: Your own Meta Marketing API access token and ad account ID (SETUP.md).
